sample_unit: abdominal CT and MRI report pairs

links.outcome: LLM discrepancy detection sensitivity on non-English (Turkish) radiology reports by model
links.effect: Event-level sensitivity differed significantly among models (p < 0.001): Claude 93.4%, GPT-5.3 91.9%, Gemini 3.0 Pro 72.6%; Claude false-positive rate 0.6%.
links.quote: Claude 4.6 Sonnet achieved the highest overall sensitivity (93.4%), followed by GPT-5.3 (91.9%) and Gemini 3.0 Pro (72.6%).

unlisted_practices: LLM-based detection of discrepancies between resident preliminary and attending final radiology reports
LLM-generated educational feedback for radiology residents

screen.reason: Retrospective benchmark study evaluating three commercial LLMs for discrepancy detection and educational feedback in Turkish resident radiology reports without comparing deployment practices or safeguards.
